description:
Correct an existing SMS registration at the needs_information step.

        The address must be accurate; saved details can be reused when still correct.
        Identity changes are rejected. This operation does not create a replacement brand.
        Actual consent evidence is required.
        Limits are 100 fields and 64 KiB of combined fields and address. No documents are uploaded.
        A later campaign filing can incur the normal review fee.
        After a timeout, the existing registration can already reflect the correction.
        Returns the updated registration or an error.

address.description: Applicant address with ``customer_name``, ``street``, ``city``, ``region``, ``postal_code`` and ``country_code``, when the requirements include one.
address.title: Address

attest_authorized.description: Attestation that the applicant reviewed and authorized the corrections. Only ``true`` is accepted.
attest_authorized.title: Attest Authorized

fields.description: Complete corrected answers that satisfy the current requirements; ``get_sms_application`` returns the saved ones.
fields.title: Fields

verification_id.description: ID of the SMS registration at step ``needs_information``, from ``list_verifications``; the same paid application and identity.
verification_id.title: Verification Id

name: amend_sms_application
title: Correct an existing SMS application
